basis: The printing heads this quaestio 'VERS. 1.' and it opens '(Cap. XXXII.—Vers. 1 et 2.) Et occurrerunt ei Angeli Dei, et dixit Jacob ut vidit eos:'. Migne prints the chapter at the head of this block.
date_basis: Written at Bethlehem and named in Jerome's own De viris illustribus 135, finished in 393, among the works already published; the preface announces it as the first of a series of Hebrew Questions on the whole of Scripture that he never continued. The early 390s is as close as the evidence held here reaches. The date is the writing, not the 1845 printing and not Vallarsi's 1767 edition.
text: (Cap. XXXII.—Vers. 1 et 2.) Et occurrerunt ei Angeli Dei, et dixit Jacob ut vidit eos: Castra Dei haec sunt, et vocavit nomen loci ejus Castra. Ubi hic castra posita sunt, in Hebraeo habet MANAIM (מחנים); ut sciamus, si quando non interpretatum in alio loco ponitur, quem locum significet. Et pulchre, ad fratrem iturus inimicum, Angelorum se comitantium excipitur choris.
